assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Reporting intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
Symptoms are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings
Evaluation for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias
Dysrhythmias may be contributing to transient neurological symptoms
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated
Service addresses documented intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
Clinical indication note describes the symptoms and necessity
